import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0]); arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
lo, mid, hi = 0, 0, n - 1
while mid <= hi:
    if arr[mid] == 0: arr[lo], arr[mid] = arr[mid], arr[lo]; lo += 1; mid += 1
    elif arr[mid] == 2: arr[mid], arr[hi] = arr[hi], arr[mid]; hi -= 1
    else: mid += 1
print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))
